credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Repurposed worn white Betke Chocolate box labeled "Retouching;" paper hinged on one side, reinforced with masking tape. Box contains 25 objects / tools for retouching photographs: pencils, china markers, erasers, Eastman Kodak spotting color swatches; ink pens and nibs, retouch ink, etc.  Box originally contained chocolate - worn label on side reads: No. 723. Oublies,  Betke's Sweetened Chocolate, Made in Holland, Nett Weight 1 LB.   Original large rectangular label on the lid of the box: in cream and Navy blue, woodcut-type image of flowers in a vase in center of label, Alice H. Marks (top), 6 East 52 nd. St.(bottom), Home.Decorating (left side), Flowers.Furniture (right side). The Alice H. Marks label on the lid most likely refers to the store selling the candy.  The interior lid of the box in imprinted with the manufacturer's label in orange, blue and white - "Chocolat -Betke- Amsterdam Holland with a building in the background.
title: Photographic Retouching Box
